"""Publish actual restored-smoke,mask arithmetic and original live V162 evidence."""
import json
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V162-flat-target-anchor-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);post=read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json');guard(post)
smoke=read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json');assert smoke['counts']==smoke['updates']=={'harmonic-control':10,'flat-anchor':10}
assert smoke['exact_V161_control_trace_rows']==10
state=torch.load(smoke['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True);finite=0
for arm in state['arms']:
 expected=state['arms'][arm]['parameter_tensors'];assert expected==46
 assert len(state['models'][arm])==len(state['emas'][arm])==len(state['optimizers'][arm]['state'])==expected
 assert all(float(s['step'])==10 for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values())
 assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for key in ['models','emas'] for v in state[key][arm].values())
 assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values() for v in s.values());finite+=expected
assert finite==92 and all(min(v.values())>0 for v in smoke['parameter_maximum_gradients'].values())
parity=read(root/'parity-result-v1.json');assert len(parity['rows'])==28 and parity['component_forward_evaluations']==56
checks=parity['CUDA_anchor_loss_checks'];assert len(checks)==10 and all(v['neural_forwards']==0 and v['leaf_backwards']==1 for v in checks)
snapshot=root/'readiness-training-prefix-v1.jsonl';assert not snapshot.exists()
with (root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').open() as stream:lines=[next(stream) for _ in range(40)]
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in lines];baseline=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace']
for i,row in enumerate(rows):
 old=baseline[i];assert row['step']==old['step'] and row['batch']==old['batch'] and row['domain']==old['domain']
 expected=old['arms']['harmonic-context'];assert {k:row['arms']['harmonic-control'][k] for k in expected}==expected
snapshot.write_text(''.join(lines))
status=read(root/'status-v1.json');poststatus=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert status['status']=='running-declared-phase' and status['phase']=='train'
assert poststatus['status']=='waiting-for-original-training-owner'
owners=[]
for role,owner in [('training-controller',status['owner']),('train-worker',status['child']),('review-controller',poststatus['owner'])]:
 p=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);assert abs(p.create_time()-owner['created'])<.01 and p.status() not in ['dead','zombie']
 owners.append({'role':role,**owner,'argv':p.cmdline(),'status':p.status()})
live_snapshot=root/'prepared-live-snapshot-v1.json';assert not live_snapshot.exists()
save(live_snapshot,{'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'training':status,'postprocess':poststatus,
    'progress':read(root/'train-progress-v1.json'),'observed_live_owners':owners,
    'scope':'Historical actual live snapshot,not final quality or final counts. Original workers continue once.'})
ready=root/'readiness-audit-v1.json';assert not ready.exists()
save(ready,{'status':'pass-actual-restored-smoke-exact-control-prefix-and-CUDA-loss-checks',
    'smoke':ref(root/'smoke-result-v1.json'),'finite_Adam_states_at10':92,
    'all92_parameter_tensors_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients':True,'exact_V161_control_prefix_rows':40,
    'training_prefix':ref(snapshot),'smoke_peak_CUDA_bytes':smoke['CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes'],
    'independent_CUDA_mask_loss_gradient_checks':10,
    'maximum_CUDA_loss_adjoint_difference':max(v['maximum_adjoint_difference'] for v in checks),
    'smoke_mask_fractions':[{'step':r['step'],'domain':r['domain'],
        'fraction':r['flat_target_mask']['eligible_pixels']/r['flat_target_mask']['total_pixels']} for r in smoke['trace']],
    'new_neural_forwards':0,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
dest=repo/'docs/results/v162-flat-target-anchor-preparation-v1';dest.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
names={'plan.json':'plan-v1.json','quality-design.json':'quality-design-v1.json','CPU-readiness.json':'CPU-readiness-v1.json',
    'parity.json':'parity-result-v1.json','smoke.json':'smoke-result-v1.json','readiness-audit.json':'readiness-audit-v1.json',
    'training-prefix.jsonl':snapshot.name,'live-snapshot.json':live_snapshot.name,
    'postprocess-imports.json':'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json','postprocess-plan.json':'postprocess-plan-v1.json',
    'retained-native-comparators.json':'native-retained-comparators-v1.json'}
copies={}
for name,source in names.items():
 p=root/source;q=dest/name;shutil.copyfile(p,q);assert p.read_bytes()==q.read_bytes();copies[name]={'original':ref(p),'public':ref(q)}
paths=list((Path(plan['work'])/'scripts').glob('*.py'))+list((Path(plan['work'])/'configs').glob('*'))
paths+=list((root/'postprocess-v1/scripts').glob('*.py'))
paths += [repo/p for p in ['scripts/flat_target_anchor.py','tests/test_flat_target_anchor.py','tests/test_late_harmonic_context.py',
    'tests/test_late_spatial_rgb.py','tests/test_regional_dc_objective.py','tests/test_local_excess_risk.py',
    'tests/test_delivered_spectral_objective.py','tests/test_robust_spectral_objective.py','tests/test_paired_response_objective.py',
    'tests/test_paired_response_data.py','tests/test_coupled_sensor_noise.py','tests/test_paired_response_counters.py',
    'tests/test_paired_response_batch_isolation.py','scripts/train_flat_target_anchor_trial.py','scripts/review_flat_target_anchor_trial.py',
    'configs/quality-v143-flat-target-anchor-v162.yaml','.cache/build-v162-controller-v1.py','.cache/prepare-v162-launch-v1.py',
    '.cache/launch-v162-v1.py','.cache/prepare-v162-postprocess-v1.py','.cache/prepare-v162-queue-v1.py',
    '.cache/queue-v162-review-v1.py','.cache/launch-v162-queue-v1.py']]
paths=list(dict.fromkeys(paths))
previous=read(Path(plan['previous'])/'plan-v1.json')
neural={p:h for p,h in previous['frozen_files'].items() if Path(p).parent.name=='demosaic'};assert len(neural)==88
for p,h in neural.items():assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==ref(Path(plan['work'])/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
bundle=dest/'source-bundle-v1.json';save(bundle,{'source_texts':[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in paths],
    'unchanged_neural_hashes':neural,'publisher':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
index=repo/'docs/results/v162-flat-target-anchor-preparation-v1.json';assert not index.exists()
save(index,{'status':'ready-original-training-live-quality-pending','recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'copies':copies,
    'sources':ref(bundle),'source_texts':len(paths),'unchanged_neural_sources':88,'new_neural_modules':0,
    'parameters_per_head':124397,'parameter_tensors_per_head':46,'flat_anchor_weights':{'control':0,'candidate':.25},
    'mask_window_native':17,'mask_tolerance_DN16':1,'anchor_unit_DN16':16,'whole_image_denominator':True,
    'actual_CPU_tests':156,'new_anchor_checks':17,'compatibility_contexts':28,'compatibility_head_calls':56,
    'additional_prefix_leaf_output_CUDA_backwards':10,'discarded_smoke_head_calls':20,
    'finite_Adam_states_after_restored_smoke':92,'exact_V161_control_prefix_rows':40,
    'fixed_heads':2,'fixed_endpoints':4,'steps_per_head':1000,'review_cases':822,'planned_review_calls':3288,
    'planned_total_scientific_head_calls_excluding_tests':5364,'planned_head_image_evaluations':11424,
    'planned_new_prediction_arrays':1644,'planned_native_images':72,'planned_triplets':24,'retained_native_columns':6,
    'planned_native_RGB_channels':54451200,'quality_complete':False,'performance_native_viewing_complete':False,
    'new_parent_DINO_source_noise_calls':0,'original_lookups':0,'RAW_decodes':0,'scope':plan['scope']})
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print('Published11 exact readiness receipts,',len(paths),'source texts,88 unchanged neural hashes,40 exact control rows;3 actual owners live')
